title: No cross-selling of other products
description: A mutual fund advertisement must not cross-sell or promote any other product or business — for example AIF or PMS offerings, insurance, or other group products. No other business may be promoted in an MF advertisement.
source_clause: Internal Dos & Don'ts (no cross-selling of other products in an MF advertisement)

pass.content: A scheme creative that stays entirely about the mutual fund scheme.

fail.content: An MF scheme creative that also pitches the AMC's PMS/AIF service and a linked insurance plan.
fail.note: Cross-sells other products in an MF ad.

title: Statistics and charts must cite a reliable source
description: Statistical information, charts, and graphs, when used, must be supported by their source. A reliable, preferably publicly available source must be quoted wherever data, graphs, or charts are shown, and the figures must be verifiable and correct.
source_clause: Internal Dos & Don'ts (statistics/charts must be source-supported); Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (a)

pass.content: The Nifty 50 delivered 15% over the last 1 year (Source: NSE, as on 31 July 2026).
pass.note: Statistic with a reliable, dated source.

fail.content: The Nifty 50 has given 15% returns in the last 1 year.

title: Content and disclaimers must be legible
description: All content of the advertisement — and especially the disclaimers and notes — must be legible and in a readable font size commensurate with the size of the other text in the creative.
source_clause: Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (i) (legible fonts); internal Dos & Don'ts (legibility / commensurate font size)

pass.content: The disclaimer is set at a font size comparable to the body copy and is clearly readable.

fail.content: The mandatory disclaimer is printed in tiny, low-contrast text crammed along the bottom edge.
fail.note: Disclaimer not legible / not commensurate — vision layer flags.
